products.name: Seismic Dampers
products.description: Engineered devices designed and manufactured to mitigate the effects of earthquakes on structures, requiring physical manufacturing and technical engineering for structural applications.

products.name: Industrial Shock Absorbers and Buffers
products.description: Manufactured shock absorption devices, including Fluidicshoks®, Crane and Industrial Buffers, and Self-Adjusting Shock Absorbers, produced in various sizes for industrial machinery, cranes, and heavy equipment, requiring precision manufacturing and engineering.

products.name: Aerospace and Defense Shock and Vibration Control Devices
products.description: Custom-designed shock absorbers, vibration dampers, machined springs, isolators, and actuators for aerospace and defense applications, involving advanced engineering, custom manufacturing, and compliance with defense standards.

products.name: Machined Springs and Liquid Die Springs
products.description: Precisely manufactured mechanical springs, including machined springs and liquid die springs, used as components in machinery, tools, dies, and aerospace applications, requiring specialized materials and manufacturing processes.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive investment management services across equity, fixed income, alternatives, multi-asset, and cash management asset classes, delivered through specialist investment managers to retail, institutional, and high-net-worth clients globally. Services include portfolio management, investment research, and risk management, typically provided under fee-based agreements tied to assets under management.

products.name: Mutual Funds and Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)
products.description: Sponsorship and management of registered and unregistered mutual funds and ETFs, including U.S. and non-U.S. funds, offered to retail and institutional investors. These funds are managed portfolios of securities, accessible directly or via financial intermediaries, and require regulatory compliance and fund administration.

products.name: Institutional Separate Accounts
products.description: Customized investment management services provided to institutional clients through separate accounts, tailored to specific investment objectives and constraints. These accounts are managed by specialist investment managers and may include a variety of asset classes and strategies.

products.name: Retail Separately Managed Account Programs
products.description: Investment management services for retail clients delivered through separately managed account programs, often sponsored by financial institutions. These programs allow clients to select from various investment strategies and typically bundle asset management, allocation, and custodial services for a single fee.

products.name: Alternative Investment Products
products.description: Management of alternative investment products such as private credit funds, hedge funds, private equity funds, real estate funds, infrastructure investments, and business development companies. These products employ specialized strategies and structures, often targeting institutional and high-net-worth investors.

products.name: High-Net-Worth Investment Management, Trust and Custody Services
products.description: Investment management, trust, and custody services for high-net-worth individuals, families, and family offices, including portfolio management, multi-manager solutions, estate planning, tax planning, and related administrative services. Delivered primarily through Fiduciary Trust International and related subsidiaries.

products.name: Sub-Advisory Services
products.description: Provision of investment management expertise as a sub-adviser to investment products sponsored by other companies, including co-branded funds. These services involve managing portfolios or strategies on behalf of third-party funds or products.

products.name: Fund Administration and Shareholder Servicing
products.description: Provision of fund administration and shareholder servicing, including transfer agency, transaction processing, client service, tax reporting, and related administrative functions for the funds managed by the company. Some services are performed directly, others are outsourced to third parties.

products.name: Sales and Distribution of Investment Products
products.description: Sales, marketing, and distribution of the company's investment products (funds and accounts) to retail, institutional, and high-net-worth clients globally, primarily through third-party financial intermediaries and the company's own distribution subsidiaries. Includes earning sales and distribution fees and managing relationships with intermediaries.

products.name: Gold Production
products.description: Extraction of gold ore through underground mining at the Golden Chest Mine, followed by processing at the New Jersey Mill using flotation and milling operations to produce gold concentrate and gold doré for sale to external customers.

products.name: Rare Earth Element (REE) Exploration and Development
products.description: Exploration, evaluation, and development of rare earth element properties in Idaho, including Mineral Hill, Lemhi Pass, and Diamond Creek, with the aim of advancing these properties for future production and sale of REE materials.

products.name: Mineral Exploration Services
products.description: Exploration and evaluation of mineral properties (gold, copper, silver, and REEs) in Idaho, including early-stage and intermediate-stage projects, with the intent to discover and develop new mineral resources for future extraction and sale.

products.name: Nivisnebart (Progranulin-Elevating Antibody Therapy)
products.description: A human recombinant monoclonal antibody therapy designed to elevate PGRN levels in the brain by blocking the SORT1 receptor, developed for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease. It is produced using advanced protein engineering and delivered intravenously or subcutaneously, requiring biologics manufacturing and regulated clinical development.

products.name: ABC-Enabled Anti-Amyloid Beta Antibody Therapy (AL137 Program)
products.description: A brain-penetrant antibody therapy targeting amyloid beta plaques for Alzheimer's disease, utilizing the proprietary Alector Brain Carrier (ABC) platform to enhance blood-brain barrier penetration. This product is manufactured as a biologic and is in preclinical development, requiring advanced antibody engineering and specialized delivery technology.

products.name: ABC-Enabled GCase Enzyme Replacement Therapy (AL050 Program)
products.description: A brain-penetrant enzyme replacement therapy for Parkinson’s disease and Lewy body dementia in patients with GBA1 gene mutations, utilizing engineered GCase enzyme and the ABC platform for enhanced delivery across the blood-brain barrier. This therapy is produced through protein engineering and biologics manufacturing.

products.name: ABC-Enabled siRNA Therapeutics Platform
products.description: A platform for developing brain-penetrant siRNA therapeutics targeting disease-related proteins (e.g., tau, alpha-synuclein, NLRP3) for neurodegenerative diseases, leveraging the ABC technology for peripheral dosing and efficient blood-brain barrier delivery. These are nucleic acid-based therapies produced using advanced molecular biology and delivery systems.

products.name: Alector Brain Carrier (ABC) Blood-Brain Barrier Delivery Platform (as a Technology Out-License)
products.description: A proprietary technology platform designed to enhance the delivery of therapeutic molecules (antibodies, enzymes, proteins, siRNA) across the blood-brain barrier via transferrin receptor targeting. While primarily used internally, the platform may be out-licensed or partnered for external use by other biopharmaceutical companies, involving technology transfer and licensing agreements.

products.name: UGG Footwear, Apparel, and Accessories
products.description: Premium footwear, apparel, and accessories designed for both casual lifestyle and high-performance activities, manufactured by independent third-party contractors and distributed globally through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: HOKA Performance Footwear, Apparel, and Accessories
products.description: Performance-oriented footwear, apparel, and accessories with enhanced cushioning and stability, originally for ultra-runners but now serving a broad range of athletic and lifestyle consumers, manufactured by independent contractors and sold worldwide via wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Teva Outdoor Footwear
products.description: Footwear designed for outdoor pursuits, including sandals, shoes, and boots, produced by independent manufacturers and distributed through outdoor retailers, department stores, and online channels.

products.name: AHNU Footwear
products.description: Footwear that fuses high-performance technology with timeless style for everyday wear, manufactured by independent contractors and sold through lifestyle boutiques and retailers.

products.name: Koolaburra Casual Footwear
products.description: Value-oriented casual footwear using plush materials, manufactured by independent contractors and distributed through wholesale channels, with operations being phased out by end of 2025.

products.name: Personal Care Services
products.description: Non-medical assistance with activities of daily living, such as bathing, grooming, feeding, medication reminders, meal preparation, housekeeping, and transportation, delivered in-home by caregivers. Also includes staffing services for assisted living facilities, nursing homes, and hospice facilities. Services are provided on a long-term basis and require significant in-person human labor and compliance with state regulations.

products.name: Hospice Services
products.description: Physical, emotional, and spiritual care for terminally ill individuals and their families, including palliative nursing care, social work, spiritual counseling, homemaker services, and bereavement counseling. Delivered primarily in-home by clinical staff and subject to federal and state healthcare regulations.

products.name: Home Health Services
products.description: Medical services provided in-home, including skilled nursing and physical, occupational, and speech therapy, typically on a short-term, intermittent, or episodic basis to assist patients recovering from illness or injury. Requires licensed clinical staff and compliance with Medicare and Medicaid regulations.

products.name: Flat-Rolled Steel Products
products.description: Manufactured through integrated steelmaking processes, including mining, primary steelmaking, and downstream finishing. Delivered as hot-rolled, cold-rolled, and coated (galvanized, aluminized, galvalume, electrogalvanized, galvanneal) steel to automotive, infrastructure, manufacturing, and distribution customers.

products.name: Automotive-Grade Steel
products.description: High-quality, technologically advanced steel products specifically engineered and finished for automotive applications, including advanced high-strength steel, cold-rolled, galvanized, aluminized, NOES, and stainless. Produced with demanding quality and delivery standards, often under long-term contracts.

products.name: Electrical Steels (GOES and NOES)
products.description: Manufactured grain-oriented (GOES) and non-oriented (NOES) electrical steels, used in transformers, electric motors (including EVs), and power grid infrastructure. Produced through specialized steelmaking and finishing processes to meet high electrical performance standards.

products.name: Stainless Steel Products
products.description: Stainless steel sheet and plate products manufactured through integrated steelmaking and finishing processes, serving automotive, infrastructure, and manufacturing markets. Delivered in various grades and forms based on customer specifications.

products.name: Steel Plate Products
products.description: Thick, flat steel plate produced via integrated steelmaking and finishing, used in infrastructure, manufacturing, and heavy equipment. Delivered to customers in construction, shipbuilding, and machinery sectors.

products.name: Tubular Products
products.description: Carbon and stainless steel tubing manufactured through specialized tube-making processes, serving automotive and industrial customers. Includes both standard and advanced-engineered tube solutions.

products.name: Stamped Components and Assemblies
products.description: Hot- and cold-stamped steel components and complex assemblies produced through stamping and tooling operations, primarily for automotive and industrial applications. Delivered as finished parts or assemblies.

products.name: Tool and Die Products and Services
products.description: Design and manufacture of tooling, dies, and related engineering services for steel forming and stamping, supporting automotive and industrial customers. Delivered as custom-built tools and dies.

products.name: Iron Ore Pellets
products.description: Iron ore pellets produced from owned and operated mines, supplied to internal steelmaking operations and sold to third-party steel producers. Requires mining, beneficiation, and pelletizing processes.

products.name: Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI)
products.description: High-quality, low-carbon direct reduced iron (HBI) produced at a dedicated facility, used as a premium scrap alternative in steelmaking and sold to third-party steel producers. Requires direct reduction technology.

products.name: Ferrous and Non-Ferrous Scrap
products.description: Processed prime and obsolete scrap metal sourced and processed at owned facilities, supplied to internal steelmaking and sold to third-party steel producers. Involves collection, sorting, and processing operations.

products.name: Coke and Metallurgical Coal
products.description: Coke and metallurgical coal produced at owned facilities and mines, supplied to internal steelmaking and sold to third-party steel producers. Involves coal mining and cokemaking processes.

products.name: Semi-Finished Steel Slabs
products.description: Semi-finished steel slabs produced via integrated steelmaking, historically supplied under contract to other steel producers. Requires casting and primary steelmaking operations.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a full range of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate lending and leasing, delivered through in-person relationship managers and digital channels, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers retail lending products such as personal loans and mortgages to individual consumers, delivered via branch network and digital platforms, requiring financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides deposit accounts including checking, savings, and certificates of deposit to consumers and businesses, delivered through physical branches and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services (WM&T)
products.description: Offers investment management, financial and retirement planning, trust and estate services, and retirement plan management for individuals and businesses, delivered by specialized professionals and digital tools, requiring fiduciary expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Provides cash management, payment processing, and related financial solutions to business clients, delivered through specialized teams and digital platforms, requiring integration with banking systems and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Card Services (Debit and Credit)
products.description: Offers debit and credit card products and related payment services to consumers and businesses, delivered via physical cards and digital payment infrastructure, requiring partnerships with payment networks and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Securities Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides securities brokerage services to customers through a third-party broker-dealer, delivered via the branch network and digital channels, requiring regulatory licensing and compliance.

products.name: Merchant Services
products.description: Offers payment processing and related services to business clients, enabling acceptance of card payments, delivered through partnerships and digital infrastructure, requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: International and Correspondent Banking Services
products.description: Provides international banking and correspondent banking services to business clients, facilitating cross-border transactions and interbank relationships, delivered through specialized teams and digital platforms.

products.name: Private Equity Fund Management
products.description: Carlyle sponsors and manages private equity funds that invest in corporate buyouts, growth capital, real estate, infrastructure, and natural resources. These funds are structured as limited partnerships and managed by teams of investment professionals who source, evaluate, and oversee investments globally.

products.name: Credit Investment Products and Fund Management
products.description: Carlyle manages a broad range of credit investment products, including liquid credit (CLOs and bank loans), opportunistic credit, direct lending, asset-backed finance, aviation finance, and infrastructure credit. These products are delivered through funds, business development companies, and structured vehicles, providing financing solutions to corporate and institutional borrowers.

products.name: Insurance Solutions and Reinsurance Asset Management
products.description: Carlyle provides insurance solutions by combining insurance expertise with portfolio construction, capital sourcing, and asset origination to deliver liability funding, reinsurance, asset management, and advisory services for reinsurance companies and fund investors. This includes managing assets for insurance clients and providing strategic advisory services.

products.name: Capital Markets and Syndication Services
products.description: Through Carlyle Global Capital Markets, the firm provides loan syndication, capital markets advisory, underwriting, origination, and placement services for loans and securities of third parties and Carlyle portfolio companies. These services are delivered via a registered broker-dealer and generate fees from underwriting, placement, and syndication activities.

products.name: Private Equity Fund of Funds and Secondary Investments
products.description: Carlyle AlpInvest provides fund of funds management, secondary purchases and financings of existing private equity portfolios, and managed co-investment programs. These services allow clients to build diversified private equity portfolios by investing in primary funds, acquiring secondary interests, and participating in co-investments alongside other funds.

products.name: GPU Compute Infrastructure Services
products.description: Provides enterprises and AI developers with on-demand access to high-performance GPU compute capacity for artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads, delivered via a distributed, asset-light network model without requiring customers to invest in physical hardware or data centers. Services are provisioned within 48 hours and sold through reserved GPU capacity contracts, with ancillary storage and CPU services available.

products.name: Digital Asset Treasury Management (ATH Token)
products.description: Manages a treasury of Aethir (ATH) tokens, including acquiring, holding, staking, and selling ATH to generate yield and liquidity. This strategy is integrated with compute services, allowing settlement of compute obligations in ATH and generating additional revenue through token-based incentives and trading activities.

products.name: AI-Driven Oncology Drug Discovery Solutions (PEDAL Platform)
products.description: Offers AI-powered drug discovery services using the proprietary PEDAL platform, which combines a large biobank of tumor samples, multi-omic data, and active machine learning to provide predictive models of tumor drug response. Services include drug screening, biomarker discovery, and drug repurposing for biopharma clients, delivered through a combination of digital analytics and laboratory testing.

products.name: 3D Tumor Modeling Services for Drug Development
products.description: Develops and provides tumor-specific in vitro 3D cell culture models that mimic the physiological environment of human tissue, enabling drug response prediction, efficacy screening, and toxicity assessment for oncology drug discovery and research. These models are used by biopharma clients for preclinical testing and pipeline prioritization.

products.name: Clinical Tumor Profiling and Biomarker Testing Services
products.description: Provides clinical diagnostic testing services for gynecological cancers, including tumor drug response testing, genomic profiling, and biomarker analysis, using patient tumor samples processed in a CLIA-certified laboratory. These services help physicians and researchers identify effective treatment options and relevant biomarkers.

products.name: Traditional Banking Services
products.description: Comprehensive banking services including deposit accounts, mortgage and consumer lending, commercial lending, treasury management, private banking, and digital banking, delivered through physical branches and digital channels. Products are produced and delivered via regulated financial infrastructure, in-person service, and digital platforms.

products.name: Warehouse Lending
products.description: Short-term, revolving credit facilities provided to mortgage bankers across the U.S., secured by single-family, first-lien residential real estate loans, enabling clients to fund closed loans until sold to investors. Delivered through financial capital and regulated lending infrastructure.

products.name: Tax Refund Solutions
products.description: Tax refund-related financial products including refund advances, early season refund advances, and refund transfers, offered through third-party tax preparers and software providers nationwide. Products are delivered via partnerships, digital processing, and regulated banking channels.

products.name: Payment Solutions
products.description: Payment-related products and services including prepaid and debit card issuing, payroll and general purpose reloadable cards, and money movement capabilities such as ACH, wire transfers, and check processing, delivered through third-party service providers and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Consumer Credit Solutions
products.description: Unsecured, small-dollar consumer loans including line-of-credit products, installment loans, and healthcare receivables, primarily to subprime or near-prime borrowers, originated and serviced via third-party providers and digital channels under bank oversight.

products.name: Vision Systems
products.description: Manufactured camera-based systems, including the MirrorEye product, that enhance vehicle visibility and safety by eliminating blind spots and improving field of view and nighttime visibility. Delivered as integrated hardware and software solutions to OEMs and aftermarket customers.

products.name: Advanced Driver Information Solutions
products.description: Custom-engineered electronic systems that collect, store, and display vehicle information such as speed, pressure, maintenance data, and driver messages. Delivered as digital hardware and software platforms to OEMs and aftermarket channels.

products.name: Connectivity and Compliance Solutions
products.description: Digital and electronic products that enable vehicle connectivity, regulatory compliance, and data communication, including telematics and fleet management solutions. Delivered as embedded systems and cloud-connected devices to OEMs and fleet operators.

products.name: Vehicle Tracking Devices and Monitoring Services
products.description: Manufactured electronic tracking devices and associated monitoring services for real-time vehicle location, status, and security. Delivered as hardware and subscription-based services to OEMs, aftermarket distributors, and direct customers.

products.name: Vehicle Security Alarms and Convenience Accessories
products.description: Electronic security alarm systems and convenience accessories such as parking sensors and rearview cameras, designed and manufactured for automotive and commercial vehicles. Delivered as hardware products through OEM and aftermarket channels.

products.name: Telematics and Multimedia Devices
products.description: Manufactured telematics solutions and multimedia/infotainment devices for vehicles, enabling connectivity, entertainment, and information access. Delivered as integrated hardware and software to OEMs and aftermarket customers.

products.name: Actuators, Sensors, Switches, and Connectors (Control Devices)
products.description: Custom-designed and manufactured actuators, sensors, switches, and connectors that monitor, measure, or activate specific vehicle functions. Products include park lock, front-axle disconnect, and various sensors for emissions, safety, powertrain, and climate systems. Delivered as physical components to OEMs in automotive, commercial, and agricultural markets. (Note: Control Devices segment sold in January 2026, but included for historical completeness.)

products.name: Community-Based Early Childhood Education and Care Services
products.description: Provision of early childhood education and care for children from six weeks to 12 years old at community-based centers, utilizing proprietary curriculum and staffed by trained educators. Services are delivered in physical centers across the U.S. and include both standard and premium offerings under the KinderCare Learning Centers and Crème School brands.

products.name: Employer-Sponsored Child Care and Education Programs
products.description: Operation of onsite or near-site early childhood education and care centers for employers, providing customized care solutions, tuition benefits, and backup care for employees’ children. These services are delivered at employer locations or through access to the broader KinderCare network.

products.name: Before- and After-School Programs and Camps
products.description: Provision of before- and after-school care, as well as summer and holiday day camps, for school-aged children (ages 5-12), primarily delivered at school sites through the Champions brand. Services include supplemental education, enrichment activities, and care outside of standard school hours.

products.name: Family Care Benefits and Tuition Assistance Programs for Employers
products.description: Business-to-business services offering employers customized family care benefits, including tuition assistance and backup care, to support employees’ access to early childhood education and care. These programs leverage KinderCare’s network and infrastructure to provide flexible care options.

products.name: Semiconductor Burn-in and Reliability Test Equipment
products.description: Designs and manufactures burn-in systems, burn-in boards, and related equipment used in the back-end manufacturing processes of semiconductors. These are physical products assembled and tested in company facilities and delivered to semiconductor manufacturers and related customers.

products.name: Semiconductor Testing Services
products.description: Provides comprehensive electrical, environmental, and burn-in testing services for semiconductor manufacturers, including component, package, and system level testing. Services are delivered in company-operated laboratories, primarily in Asia, using specialized equipment and technical expertise.

products.name: Distribution of Semiconductor Test Equipment and Electronic Components
products.description: Distributes burn-in test related equipment and a wide range of electronic components such as connectors, sockets, cables, LCD displays, and touch screen panels. Acts as a value-added reseller by customizing and integrating products to customer specifications.

products.name: Industrial Test and Process Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and distributes test, process, and other equipment for manufacturing processes in various industries, including environmental chambers, leak detectors, autoclaves, centrifuges, dynamic testers, HAST testers, and temperature-controlled chucks. These are physical products produced in company facilities and delivered to industrial and consumer market customers.

products.name: Maintenance, Calibration, and Refurbishment Services for Industrial Equipment
products.description: Provides preventive maintenance, calibration, repair, upgrading, and refurbishment services for temperature, humidity, and pressurization equipment used in industrial and consumer applications. Services are delivered on-site or at company facilities by specialized technical staff.

products.name: Radio Broadcasting and Advertising
products.description: Operation of 76 revenue-producing radio stations in major urban markets, primarily targeting African-American and urban listeners, generating revenue mainly through the sale of local, national, and network advertising. Content is produced and delivered via terrestrial radio infrastructure and in-person talent, regulated by the FCC.

products.name: Syndicated Radio Programming and Advertising
products.description: Production and syndication of nationally recognized radio shows (e.g., Rickey Smiley Morning Show, Get Up! Mornings with Erica Campbell, DL Hughley Show) distributed on both Urban One and non-Urban One stations, with revenue from advertising sales. Content is created by in-house talent and distributed via affiliate agreements.

products.name: Cable Television Networks and Advertising
products.description: Operation of cable television networks (TV One and CLEO TV) targeting African-American and urban audiences, generating revenue from advertising sales and affiliate fees paid by cable and satellite distributors. Content is produced or acquired and delivered via regulated cable infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Media Platforms and Advertising
products.description: Operation of digital media properties (iONE Digital, Cassius, Bossip, HipHopWired, MadameNoire) and radio station websites, serving the African-American community with news, entertainment, and social content. Revenue is generated from digital advertising, including banner and sponsorship ads, and studio services for other publishers. Content is produced digitally and delivered online.

products.name: Ersodetug for Congenital Hyperinsulinism
products.description: An intravenously administered human monoclonal antibody therapy developed to treat hypoglycemia caused by congenital hyperinsulinism, produced through biotechnological processes and delivered via infusion in clinical settings.

products.name: Ersodetug for Tumor Hyperinsulinism
products.description: A biotechnologically produced monoclonal antibody therapy administered intravenously for the treatment of hypoglycemia due to tumor-induced hyperinsulinism, delivered in clinical and hospital settings.

products.name: Expanded Access Program for Ersodetug
products.description: A compassionate use program providing access to ersodetug for patients with various forms of hyperinsulinism who have failed available therapeutic options, involving individualized clinical administration outside of formal trials.

products.name: Uniform Rental and Facility Services
products.description: Rental and servicing of uniforms and other garments, including flame resistant clothing, mats, mops, shop towels, and ancillary items, delivered via local routes and processed in company facilities.

products.name: Restroom and Facility Supplies and Cleaning Services
products.description: Provision of restroom cleaning services and supplies, including items sold from catalogs, delivered and serviced through local routes and distribution centers.

products.name: First Aid and Safety Products and Services
products.description: Distribution and servicing of first aid and safety products, including eye-wash stations and safety training, delivered via distribution network and local representatives.

products.name: Workplace Water Services
products.description: Provision of workplace water services, including delivery and maintenance of water supplies for businesses, through local delivery routes and distribution centers.

products.name: Fire Protection Services
products.description: Provision, inspection, and maintenance of fire extinguishers, sprinkler systems, and alarm testing for business facilities, delivered and serviced by local representatives.

products.name: Uniform Direct Sale
products.description: Direct sale of uniforms and related apparel to customers, manufactured in company facilities or sourced from suppliers, distributed via catalog and delivery network.

products.name: HPC Data Center Infrastructure Leasing
products.description: Development, ownership, and leasing of high-performance computing (HPC) and AI-ready data center infrastructure to hyperscalers, cloud service providers, AI companies, and enterprises. This involves physical construction and operation of data centers with advanced power, cooling, and fiber connectivity, delivered under long-term lease agreements.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining Services
products.description: Operation of large-scale Bitcoin mining facilities using ASIC miners, contributing hashrate to mining pools and earning revenue in Bitcoin. This business line includes the management of mining hardware, facility operations, and associated power infrastructure, with revenue generated from mining rewards and pool participation.

products.name: Wholesale Power Generation and Sales
products.description: Ownership and operation of power generation facilities (including waste-to-energy plants) that generate electricity for sale into wholesale power markets (such as PJM), as well as for self-supply to collocated data centers. This includes the sale of capacity, energy, and ancillary services, and participation in demand response and energy arbitrage programs.

products.name: CNS and Psychiatric Therapeutics
products.description: Development and commercialization of novel therapeutics, including conventional drugs and psychedelic formulations, targeting central nervous system (CNS) diseases and psychiatric disorders such as PTSD, anxiety, depression, fibromyalgia, Alzheimer's disease, and multiple sclerosis. These are delivered via proprietary intranasal sprays, subcutaneous implants, and peptide-guided drug delivery systems, requiring regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: Cryptocurrency Staking and Treasury Management
products.description: Acquisition, holding, and staking of leading digital assets such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, including participation in native and liquid staking to generate yield. This involves financial capital management and digital asset custody through third-party custodians, with the company acting as a delegator in blockchain networks.

products.name: Aerospace Sensors, Controls, and Actuation Components
products.description: Highly engineered sensors, controls, and electro-mechanical actuation components manufactured and assembled for use in commercial and military aerospace and industrial applications. Delivered through precision manufacturing and distributed via commercial sales channels.

products.name: Surface Technology Services
products.description: Material modification services including shot peening, laser peening, and engineered coatings, applied to components for commercial and defense markets to enhance efficiency, safety, and longevity. Delivered through specialized service centers and manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Industrial and Specialty Vehicle Products
products.description: Manufactured power management electronics, traction inverters, transmission shifters, and control systems for industrial and specialty vehicles, supporting global industrial, commercial vehicle, medical, and transportation industries. Products are assembled and tested to commercial grade specifications.

products.name: Defense Embedded Computing and Electronics
products.description: COTS embedded computing modules, processing equipment, integrated subsystems, instrumentation and control systems, and electronic stabilization products for defense platforms. Products are ruggedized and manufactured to stringent military specifications, distributed through regulated government contracting channels.

products.name: Tactical Communications Solutions
products.description: Battlefield network management and tactical communications equipment designed and manufactured for military use, supporting secure and net-centric operations. Delivered as hardware and integrated systems to government and defense contractors.

products.name: Avionics and Flight Test Equipment
products.description: Avionics, flight test instrumentation, and aircraft data recorder and management solutions for commercial and military aerospace applications. Products are manufactured and tested to meet stringent aerospace standards.

products.name: Naval Propulsion and Auxiliary Equipment
products.description: Manufactured naval propulsion and auxiliary equipment including main coolant pumps, compact motors, generators, steam turbines, valves, and secondary propulsion systems for naval defense platforms, primarily for the U.S. Navy. Delivered through precision manufacturing and government contracting.

products.name: Ship Repair and Maintenance Services
products.description: Repair and maintenance services for U.S. Navy fleets and naval industrial base, provided through coastal service centers. Services include overhaul, repair, and maintenance of naval vessels and equipment.

products.name: Aircraft Arresting Systems
products.description: Manufactured aircraft arresting systems including energy absorbers, retractable hook cable systems, net-stanchion systems, and mobile systems for fixed land-based and military applications. Delivered as engineered systems to defense and aerospace customers.

products.name: Nuclear Power Plant Equipment and Services
products.description: Hardware, valves, fastening systems, containment doors, airlock hatches, simulation equipment, and spent fuel management products for commercial nuclear power plants. Includes maintenance, modernization, and new build support, manufactured and serviced to nuclear industry standards.

products.name: Reactor Coolant Pumps and Control Rod Drive Mechanisms
products.description: Manufactured Reactor Coolant Pumps (RCPs) and control rod drive mechanisms for new commercial nuclear power plants, notably for advanced reactor designs. Delivered as critical components to nuclear equipment manufacturers and utilities.

products.name: Severe-Service Valve Technologies and Process Equipment
products.description: Specialized severe-service valve technologies, heat exchanger repair, and piping test and isolation products for oil and gas, chemical, petrochemical, and industrial markets. Products are engineered and manufactured for demanding process environments.

products.name: Subsea Pumping Technology
products.description: Development and supply of critical subsea pumping technology for the oil and gas industry, leveraging expertise in canned motor pumps. Products are engineered for subsea and harsh environments.

products.name: Consumer and Commercial Banking Services
products.description: A full suite of traditional banking services, including checking and savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and other deposit products, delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital channels. These services require regulated infrastructure and in-person as well as digital delivery.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to businesses, including term loans, revolving lines of credit, and loans secured by business assets, underwritten based on creditworthiness and collateral. Delivered through in-person relationship management and regulated lending infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Loans secured by owner-occupied and non-owner occupied commercial properties, underwritten based on cash flow and collateral value, requiring property appraisals and regulatory compliance. Delivered through specialized lending teams and branch offices.

products.name: Real Estate Construction Lending
products.description: Financing for real estate development and construction, including loans to developers and residential builders, secured by properties under development and often supported by personal guarantees. Delivered through specialized lending teams and subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of first lien mortgages, home equity loans, and lines of credit for individuals to purchase, refinance, or leverage residential real estate. Includes both conforming and non-conforming loans, delivered through branch and mortgage loan offices, and subject to regulatory standards.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer installment loans, personal lines of credit, credit cards, and indirect automobile and recreational vehicle loans to individuals. Delivered through branch offices and digital channels, requiring credit underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Equipment Leasing and Finance
products.description: Leasing and financing solutions for business equipment, delivered through a dedicated division. Involves underwriting, asset management, and regulatory compliance, and is provided to commercial customers.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Provision of trust administration, investment management, and wealth advisory services to individuals and institutions, delivered through specialized teams and requiring fiduciary expertise and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Insurance Products
products.description: Offering of insurance products to customers, including through a dedicated insurance agency subsidiary. Delivered via licensed agents and requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of one-to-four family residential mortgage loans, including jumbo and conventional loans, primarily secured by properties in the local market and Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex. Loans are underwritten to Freddie Mac guidelines and are generally fixed-rate, requiring in-person underwriting and regulated processes.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including self-storage facilities, gas stations, and rental properties. These loans are typically adjustable-rate, require property appraisals, and involve significant underwriting and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Construction and Land Lending
products.description: Provision of loans for construction of residential and commercial properties, as well as land loans for development or investment. These loans are secured by the underlying property and require inspections, appraisals, and close monitoring during the construction phase.

products.name: Multi-Family Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for multi-family properties such as apartment complexes and townhomes, following commercial real estate loan guidelines. These loans are secured by the property and require detailed underwriting and appraisals.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to small businesses, secured by business assets such as equipment and accounts receivable. These loans are typically short- to medium-term and require financial analysis of the borrower's business and collateral.

products.name: Municipal Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to municipalities, political subdivisions, and school districts, primarily secured by tax or revenue pledges. These loans are subject to public sector underwriting and regulatory requirements.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans secured by used automobiles, recreational vehicles, boats, and deposit accounts. These loans are typically smaller, fixed-rate, and require standard consumer credit underwriting.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts to customers, including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and individual retirement accounts. These services are delivered through physical branches and digital channels, and are regulated and insured.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales
products.description: Investment in and management of securities portfolios, including mortgage-backed securities, collateralized mortgage obligations, corporate bonds, and municipal securities. These are managed for yield and liquidity, not typically sold to external customers, but are a core banking activity.

products.name: NXC-201 CAR-T Cell Therapy
products.description: A next-generation autologous chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T) therapy targeting B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA), produced using proprietary cell engineering and manufacturing processes, designed for the treatment of relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis and select other serious diseases. The therapy is manufactured according to cGMP standards and delivered to patients via clinical administration after ex vivo modification of their own immune cells.

products.name: SBA 7(a) Lending
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of loans partially guaranteed by the Small Business Administration (SBA) to small businesses and professionals nationwide. Loans are originated through relationships with third parties and may be retained or sold in the secondary market, with the bank retaining servicing rights. Requires regulatory compliance and specialized underwriting.

products.name: Strategic Program Lending
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of consumer and small commercial loans nationwide through partnerships with fintech platforms. Loans are originated using technology-driven platforms, with most originations sold to investors and a portion retained for investment. Includes both standard and credit-enhanced products, with automated underwriting and digital delivery.

products.name: Residential and Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination and holding of loans secured by residential and commercial real estate, including construction, development, and acquisition loans. Delivered primarily through a single branch location with a relationship banking approach, these loans are typically held on balance sheet and require in-person underwriting and collateral management.

products.name: Equipment Financing
products.description: Origination and holding of loans and leases for equipment purchases by businesses, secured by liens on business assets. Underwriting is based on commercial credit metrics and collateral, and loans are generally retained for investment.

products.name: Consumer Point-of-Sale (POS) Lending
products.description: Origination of collateralized and uncollateralized consumer loans at the point of sale to finance retail goods and services. Applications are submitted online, with a high degree of automation and digital credit analysis. Loans are typically held on balance sheet.

products.name: Commercial Non-Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination and holding of loans, lines of credit, and letters of credit to commercial enterprises for business purposes, not secured by real estate. Underwriting is based on business cash flow and collateral, and loans are generally retained for investment.

products.name: Deposit Products and Services
products.description: Provision of a full range of deposit products and services, including checking and savings accounts, time deposits, money market accounts, debit cards, remote deposit capture, online and mobile banking, and direct deposit. Includes business accounts and cash management services. Delivered through branch and digital channels.

products.name: Consumer Installment Loans
products.description: Unsecured, fixed-rate loans offered online to consumers in the U.S. and Brazil, typically ranging from $300 to $10,000 with terms between 3 and 60 months. Loans are originated, arranged, or guaranteed using proprietary technology and analytics, and funds are deposited directly to customers' bank accounts.

products.name: Small Business Installment Loans
products.description: Online unsecured installment loans for small businesses in the U.S., with loan sizes from $5,000 to $400,000 and terms between 6 and 24 months. Loans are originated or arranged using proprietary underwriting and technology platforms, and funds are deposited to business bank accounts.

products.name: Consumer Line of Credit Accounts
products.description: Online unsecured revolving credit lines for consumers in the U.S., allowing flexible draws up to a credit limit ($100 to $7,000). Customers access funds and manage accounts via web or mobile platforms, with fees or interest charged on drawn amounts.

products.name: Small Business Line of Credit Accounts
products.description: Online unsecured revolving credit lines for small businesses in the U.S., with credit limits from $5,000 to $200,000 and terms of 12 to 24 months. Businesses can draw funds as needed and repay with regular amortizing payments.

products.name: Credit Services Organization (CSO) Program
products.description: Credit-related services provided to consumers in Texas, including arranging and guaranteeing installment loans from third-party lenders. The company acts as a credit services organization, assisting with loan applications and guaranteeing repayment for a fee.

products.name: Bank Program Loan Servicing and Marketing Services
products.description: Marketing and loan servicing services provided to partner banks for consumer and small business installment loans and lines of credit. The company receives marketing and servicing fees, and may purchase loans or receivables originated by the banks.

products.name: International Money Transfer Services
products.description: Digital money transfer services under the Pangea brand, enabling U.S. customers to send funds to recipients in Mexico, other Latin American countries, and Asia. The service is accessed via web or mobile apps, with revenue from transfer fees and exchange rate spreads.

products.name: Hearing Enhancement and Protection Products
products.description: AXIL designs, manufactures, markets, and distributes advanced hearing enhancement and protection products such as earplugs, earmuffs, earbuds, and outdoor speakers, many incorporating Bluetooth and wireless audio technologies. These are produced through a combination of in-house manufacturing and third-party design, and delivered via direct-to-consumer e-commerce, third-party platforms, dealers, and retail chains.

products.name: Professional-Grade Hair and Skin Care Products
products.description: AXIL offers professional-grade hair and skin care products, including shampoos, conditioners, scalp treatments, styling aids, and skin health solutions, manufactured through third-party co-packers and partners. These products are distributed via e-commerce, distributors, and professional salon partnerships.

products.name: Marketing Services
products.description: Through its subsidiary Sharper Vision Marketing Inc., AXIL plans to offer marketing services to third-party clients, leveraging its internal marketing expertise. This service is newly established and aims to convert a historical cost center into a revenue stream.

products.name: Intelligent Power Semiconductor Devices
products.description: Discrete, module, and integrated semiconductor devices (including SiC, GaN, MOSFETs, FETs, diodes, and power modules) designed and manufactured for high-efficiency and high-power conversion in automotive, industrial, energy infrastructure, and AI data center applications. These products are physically manufactured using advanced fabrication and packaging technologies.

products.name: Analog and Mixed-Signal Semiconductor Solutions
products.description: Analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits, including power management, sensor interface, connectivity, and standard products such as controllers, gate drivers, converters, protection devices, and logic, delivered as physical chips for automotive, industrial automation, AI data center, computing, and mobile markets. These are manufactured using semiconductor fabrication and assembly processes.

products.name: Intelligent Sensing and Imaging Solutions
products.description: Advanced imaging and sensing semiconductor products, including CMOS image sensors, image signal processors, SWIR sensors, photon-counting devices, and depth sensing technologies, physically manufactured for use in automotive ADAS, industrial automation, robotics, and AI-enabled perception systems.

products.name: Integrated Payment Processing Solutions
products.description: A full suite of end-to-end payment processing services supporting multiple payment types (credit, debit, contactless, EMV, QR, mobile wallets, alternative payments) delivered via proprietary gateway and integrations with hundreds of software suites. Requires regulated infrastructure, security compliance, and operates across in-store, online, and mobile channels.

products.name: Point-of-Sale (POS) Solutions
products.description: Hardware and software POS systems, including SkyTab POS workstations and SkyTab Mobile, providing integrated payment functionality, order management, and business operations tools for merchants in various industries. Delivered as physical devices with pre-loaded software and cloud-based management.

products.name: eCommerce Platform
products.description: A turnkey digital platform (Shift4Shop) enabling merchants to build, host, and manage online stores, including webstore design, shopping cart, order fulfillment, inventory management, and secure hosting. Delivered as a cloud-based SaaS solution.

products.name: Tax-Free Shopping (TFS) Services
products.description: Cloud-based VAT refund processing solutions for merchants and travelers, facilitating tax-free shopping and VAT refunds across global markets. Requires integration with acquirers, POS partners, and customs validation systems, and compliance with complex international regulations.

products.name: Business Intelligence and Analytics Tools
products.description: Cloud-based business intelligence suite (Lighthouse) offering reporting, analytics, customer engagement, social media management, scheduling, and product pricing tools. Delivered digitally as SaaS, integrated with payment and POS systems.

products.name: Marketplace Integrations
products.description: A digital marketplace enabling seamless integration of third-party applications (e.g., delivery, payroll, HR, loyalty, inventory management) into merchant POS and payment systems, reducing vendor fragmentation and manual workflows. Delivered as software integrations.

products.name: Cryptocurrency Donation Marketplace
products.description: A digital platform (The Giving Block) facilitating cryptocurrency donations to charities, allowing donors to gift various cryptocurrencies to thousands of nonprofits. Delivered as an online marketplace integrated with payment processing.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate, multi-family, asset-based, equipment finance, lender finance, venture capital, warehouse, and SBA loans. These are originated and serviced through in-person relationship banking and digital channels, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Products and Services
products.description: Offers traditional deposit accounts such as checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and retirement accounts, as well as safe deposit boxes. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking platforms, these products are insured and regulated.

products.name: Treasury and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides tailored cash management and treasury management solutions, including automated bill payments, master demand accounts, foreign exchange, interest rate swaps, liquidity management, and remote/mobile deposit capture. Delivered via digital platforms and supported by specialized staff.

products.name: Payment Processing Solutions
products.description: Delivers integrated electronic payment capabilities for commercial clients, including merchant acquiring and card issuing services, through proprietary platforms like BancEdge. Involves secure transaction processing, settlement, and regulatory compliance, supporting both physical and digital payment channels.

products.name: Client Investment Funds and Corporate Treasury Solutions
products.description: Offers alternative, non-depository investment options for clients to invest excess liquidity, including off-balance sheet funds and specialized treasury solutions. These are managed through digital and relationship channels and require financial expertise and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides consumer loans, including purchased private student loans, auto loans, personal loans, and home equity lines. These are originated or purchased, require credit underwriting, and are delivered through digital and branch channels.

products.name: HOA and Community Association Banking Services
products.description: Provides specialized banking and payment solutions to the Community Association Management industry, including deposit, lending, and technology-forward platforms like SmartStreet™. Delivered nationwide with a focus on technology integration and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Research Journals Publishing
products.description: Publishing and global distribution of over 1,800 scientific, technical, medical, and scholarly journals, primarily delivered digitally via the Wiley Online Library platform and through multi-year contracts with institutions and societies.

products.name: Open Access Publishing
products.description: Publication of peer-reviewed research articles under open access models (Hybrid and Gold), where authors or funders pay article publication charges for immediate, free online access; includes workflow and infrastructure support for authors and institutions.

products.name: Content Licensing and Ancillary Products (Research)
products.description: Licensing of publishing rights and content for uses such as AI model training, reproductions, translations, individual article sales, and backfile access, delivered digitally to publishers, developers, and institutions.

products.name: Research Solutions and Platforms
products.description: Provision of digital content platforms, workflow solutions, and services for corporations and societies, including advertising, marketing, recruitment platforms, spectral database licenses, and the Atypon publishing platform for content hosting and peer review.

products.name: Academic Publishing (Print and Digital)
products.description: Publishing and global distribution of scientific, technical, medical, and educational books and reference materials in print and digital formats, sold through retailers, libraries, and direct channels; includes custom and adapted content for institutions and corporations.

products.name: Digital Courseware and Learning Platforms
products.description: Development and delivery of interactive digital courseware and online learning platforms (e.g., WileyPLUS, zyBooks) for higher education and STEM disciplines, providing integrated textbooks, assessments, and hands-on learning experiences.

products.name: Content Licensing and Ancillary Products (Learning)
products.description: Licensing of educational and professional content for uses such as co-publishing, reproductions, translations, digital uses, and AI model training, provided to publishers, developers, and institutions.

products.name: Professional Publishing
products.description: Publishing and distribution of professional books and reference materials in business, finance, technology, and other fields, sold through retailers, wholesalers, corporations, and government agencies; includes custom publications for organizations.

products.name: Assessments and Soft-Skills Training Solutions
products.description: Development and delivery of branded assessment tools and soft-skills training solutions (e.g., Everything DiSC, The Five Behaviors, Leadership Practices Inventory, PXT Select) for organizations and their employees, primarily delivered digitally or through authorized consultants.
